agentic_insight.summary: Statistical prediction for a Saturday is 249 items [1]. The agent forecasts 316 (+27%), a lift of about 67 items from two events. Tavily lists the Warriors vs Kings preseason game at Chase Center, tip-off 17:30 [2], and the Fleet Week Air Show, 12:00 to 16:00 [3]. Mem0's best match is the Valkyries' Saturday 17:30 game on <<2026-09-19|Sep 19>>, the same tip-off time: +17%, with sales rising from early afternoon [4]. There is no earlier Fleet Week to compare, so the air show gets a small +10% allowance [5]. Why this matters for the day's shape: a 17:30 tip-off pulls the pre-game rush to about 14:30 to 17:30, where it overlaps the tail of the Air Show. The usual 14:00 to 16:00 lull largely disappears: those hours run more than double the Saturday trend. The agent leans on Saturday's high base (249 items), so the lift is a smaller share than on a weekday. Sunny and warm [6], which helps both the air show and foot traffic.

sources.query:
SELECT day_of_week,
       ROUND(AVG(baseline_items), 1) AS baseline_items,
       COUNT(*)                      AS n_days
FROM   daily_trend
WHERE  day_of_week = 'Saturday'
  AND  date < '2026-10-10'
GROUP  BY day_of_week;
sources.note: daily_trend rolls the sales table up per day; baseline_items is the no-event trend for that weekday.
